app.name: Mirkomil Host
admin.title: Administrative access
admin.on: Administrative access is on: the panel can manage the system (services, updates, reboot). Such actions carry an "admin" badge and are written to the activity log.
admin.off: You are in limited mode: view only. Turn on administrative access to manage the system.
simple.ok.title: All good
simple.footer: Dangerous actions (reboot, delete) always ask for confirmation and are logged.
page.soon.body: This page arrives in the next milestone ({m}).
error.title: Something went wrong in this section
error.body: The rest of the panel still works. Retry, or copy the details.
terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.note: This is Cockpit's own terminal — it runs as the logged-in user.
settings.title: Settings
guardian.title: Guardian
guardian.unavailable: The Guardian agent is not running or not installed.
guardian.unavailable.hint: Run on the server: sudo mirkomil repair
chart.needsGuardian: 24h / 7d history comes from the Guardian agent
guardian.mode.dryrun.help: Guardian only records what it would do and changes nothing. Watch the timeline for a few days, then switch to Automatic.
guardian.mode.auto.help: Guardian fixes problems itself and records them in the timeline and Telegram.
guardian.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change this
files.body: Files open in Cockpit's file manager — with your own permissions.
chart.net.note: Network — relative to the peak in range
quick.title: Quick actions
projects.title: Active projects
projects.empty.title: No projects yet
projects.empty.body: Deploy a GitHub project in a few clicks — coming in the next milestone (M5).
projects.col.name: Project
activity.title: Recent activity
alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.noAgent: Guardian agent not running — alerts unavailable
admin.intro: Enter your password for system actions (services, updates, reboot). It goes straight to the system (sudo) and is never stored.
admin.failed: Could not turn on administrative access
admin.noBridge: This user has no sudo rights.
files.missing: The file manager (cockpit-files) is not installed. Run on the server:
action.needAdmin: Turn on administrative access (shield button at the top)
services.title: Services
svc.confirm.stop: “{unit}” will be stopped. Anything depending on it may stop working.
svc.confirm.restart: “{unit}” will be restarted. Expect a few seconds of downtime.
svc.confirm.disable: “{unit}” will no longer start on boot.
power.title: Power
power.intro: Reboot or shut down the server. Both require typing the server name and are logged.
power.reboot.body: The server restarts. Bots and apps stop for 1–2 minutes, then start again.
power.shutdown.body: The server powers off completely. You will need physical access to turn it back on!
power.sent: Command sent. The connection will drop — refresh in a minute or two.
updates.title: Updates
updates.reboot.body: The new kernel or libraries take effect after a reboot.
updates.confirm: {n} packages will be upgraded. This can take a few minutes; some services restart briefly.
updates.auto: Security updates install automatically every day (unattended-upgrades).
logs.title: Logs
logs.journalNote: The full system journal needs the “adm” group or administrative access.
activityPage.title: Activity log
activityPage.intro: Important actions done through the panel (who, what, target, result) and Guardian's automatic actions.
activityPage.empty: No actions through the panel yet
sec.title: Security
sec.needAdmin: Turn on administrative access for the full check — only root can read the firewall, fail2ban and SSH settings.
sec.firewall.on: On — incoming connections denied by default
sec.unban.confirm: {ip} will be unbanned and may try to connect again.
sec.rec.ufw: Enable the firewall: sudo mirkomil repair
sec.rec.f2b: Start fail2ban: sudo systemctl enable --now fail2ban
sec.rec.password: Add an SSH key and disable password login (sudo mirkomil repair)
sec.rec.none: Everything is configured well — no recommendations
identity.title: Server identity
identity.intro: The name and domain are used on the login page, panel, browser title and Telegram alerts. Changing them updates everything.
identity.name: Server / hosting name
identity.saved: Saved. The login page updates — you will need to log in again in about 10 seconds.
identity.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change this
deploy.title: Deploy / Projects
deploy.intro: Deploy a GitHub project in a few clicks: the type is detected automatically and it runs in a hardened container.
deploy.empty.title: No projects yet
deploy.empty.body: Paste a GitHub URL — the panel clones, builds, health-checks and runs it.
deploy.domainNote: Public access is enabled in M6 (Cloudflare Tunnel)
wizard.title: New project
wizard.name: Project name
wizard.envHint: Secrets are stored root-only on the server and are never shown again.
wizard.invalidName: 3–32 chars: lowercase letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter
app.rollback.confirm: The app rolls back to {id} (the old image is started again).
app.delete.body: “{name}” is removed completely: containers, images, code and env. This cannot be undone.
app.settings.saved: Saved. Applied on the next deploy.
app.notDeployed: The app has not been deployed successfully yet.
docker.title: Docker
docker.intro: All containers on the server. Mirkomil apps start with “mk-”.
docker.prune.body: Unused images and build cache are removed. Volumes (data) and running containers are not touched.
docker.adminOnly: The Docker page is for administrators only.
docker.col.name: Name
db.title: Databases
db.intro: PostgreSQL and Redis in one click. Passwords are generated and stay on the server; databases are not reachable from outside.
db.name: Database name
db.empty.title: No databases yet
db.empty.body: Create PostgreSQL (for Django, FastAPI) or Redis (cache, queues, bot state) and attach it to a project.
db.attached: Attached to {app} as {var}. Redeploy to apply.
db.delete.body: The “{name}” container is removed. Data (volume) is KEPT by default.
db.dropData: Also delete the data (cannot be undone)
auto.title: Auto-deploy
auto.help: Guardian checks the branch every 5 minutes and deploys new commits itself. A broken commit is not retried.
key.title: Private repo (deploy key)
key.help: For a private repo use git@github.com:owner/repo.git and add this public key in GitHub → Settings → Deploy keys (read-only). The private key never leaves the server.
wizard.repoHintPrivate: Private: git@github.com:<owner>/<repo>.git — then add the deploy key in Settings
